fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials (AMAT) adjusted EPS grew 41%, DRAM revenue increased 52%, but stock fell 26.3% in October while continuing investment in hybrid bonding technology and expanded Besi stake (approximately 20%).
fields.summary_ko.1: Amid chip sector ETF selling and volatility, fundamental improvement and upward revenue guidance were recorded, with credibility of long-term growth narrative as key variable.
